_source: CASA exam pages for RPLA and PPLA (casa.gov.au, retrieved 2026-10-03). Question counts are not published by CASA; 60 is used for both simulators, matching the 55-60 typically reported by candidates.

exams.name: Recreational pilot licence (aeroplane)
casa_weak_areas: effect of wind shear on aircraft performance
interpretation of meteorological forecasts and requirements
local winds: sea breeze, land breeze, anabatic and katabatic winds
use of the take-off and landing charts
exams.fuel_policy: Fuel reserves per CASR Part 91 MOS Chapter 19, table 19.02(2) item 1 (aeroplane below 5,700 kg, VFR by day). Avoid rounding at intermediate stages.

exams.name: Private pilot licence (aeroplane)
casa_weak_areas: correct use of the take-off and landing charts
finding time/distance and revision of estimates
working out density height and/or pressure height
correct use of the loading systems (ALPHA, BRAVO and CHARLIE)
exams.fuel_policy: Fuel reserves per CASR Part 91 MOS Chapter 19, table 19.02(2) item 1 (aeroplane below 5,700 kg, VFR by day). Avoid rounding at intermediate stages.
